model_annotation: This plot illustrates the comparison of different models, specifically StrmLLM and SepLLM, with varying parameters. The x-axis is labeled but the label is not provided; it has a linear scale with a value range from approximately 0 to 25 and is marked with ticks at regular intervals of 5 units. The y-axis is also unlabeled; it has a logarithmic scale with a value range from approximately $10^{-4}$ to $10^{3}$ and is marked with ticks at regular intervals. The plot contains five lines: a blue line representing StrmLLM (n=64) with no markers and a solid line style; an orange line representing SepLLM (n=64) with no markers and a solid line style; a green line representing SepLLM (n=64, H) with no markers and a solid line style; a red line representing SepLLM (n=64, H/T) with no markers and a solid line style; and a purple line representing SepLLM (n=128) with no markers and a solid line style. The blue line starts at approximately (0, $10^{3}$) and decreases to approximately (25, $10^{-2}$). The orange, green, red, and purple lines start at approximately (0, $10^{2}$) and decrease to approximately (25, $10^{-2}$). All lines exhibit a sharp decline from the start and then level off, with the blue line consistently above the other lines.
